# Keywords

A keyword is a word or phrase Mentio watches, matched case-insensitively as a phrase on every platform or on the ones in `platforms`. `kind` says what it is to the workspace: `brand` (their own names), `competitor` (the others), `topic` (the space); share of voice and segments read it. Matching, classification and delivery start on the next poll of each platform (real time on Bluesky, minutes to an hour elsewhere, up to 12 hours on YouTube).

Before creating one, list the keywords: the same normalized term twice is a `409 duplicate_keyword`. A keyword costs $5 per month, debited daily from the prepaid balance, and every mention it matches $0.008; a `402` means the balance cannot cover it (see rules/errors.md). Muting stops polling and matching but keeps the mentions; deleting removes the keyword and its matches (posts also matched by another keyword stay). Confirm with the user before deleting.

`stats` counts every match ever (`mentions`, the billed number), the relevant ones, and the last 7 days. `polling` reports, per polled platform, the last poll and how many polls in a row found nothing, which is how you tell "nothing is being said" from "not polled yet".

Base URL `https://api.mentio.dev`, `Authorization: Bearer $MENTIO_API_KEY` on every request, JSON in and out. The `mentio` CLI command for each endpoint is listed for when it is installed (rules/cli.md).

## Examples

```bash
# Every keyword with its stats and poll health
curl -sS "https://api.mentio.dev/v1/keywords" -H "Authorization: Bearer $MENTIO_API_KEY"

# Track a brand term on two platforms only
curl -sS -X POST "https://api.mentio.dev/v1/keywords" -H "Authorization: Bearer $MENTIO_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"term": "acme", "kind": "brand", "platforms": ["reddit", "hackernews"]}'

# Track a competitor everywhere
curl -sS -X POST "https://api.mentio.dev/v1/keywords" -H "Authorization: Bearer $MENTIO_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"term": "globex", "kind": "competitor"}'

# Pause one, then widen it back to every platform
curl -sS -X PATCH "https://api.mentio.dev/v1/keywords/kw_60d9..." -H "Authorization: Bearer $MENTIO_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"muted": true}'
curl -sS -X PATCH "https://api.mentio.dev/v1/keywords/kw_60d9..." -H "Authorization: Bearer $MENTIO_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"platforms": null}'
```

## Endpoints

| Method | Path | CLI | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/v1/keywords` | `mentio keywords:list` | List keywords |
| `POST` | `/v1/keywords` | `mentio keywords:create` | Track a keyword |
| `GET` | `/v1/keywords/{id}` | `mentio keywords:get` | Get a keyword |
| `PATCH` | `/v1/keywords/{id}` | `mentio keywords:update` | Update a keyword |
| `DELETE` | `/v1/keywords/{id}` | `mentio keywords:delete` | Delete a keyword |

### GET /v1/keywords

**List keywords.** Every keyword of the workspace, newest first, with its match stats and poll health.

CLI: `mentio keywords:list`

Returns: 200, `{ data: Keyword[] }` (see Shapes below).

### POST /v1/keywords

**Track a keyword.** Start tracking a word or phrase. Matching, classification and delivery begin on the next poll. A funded workspace tracks up to 500 keywords; each costs $5 per month, deducted daily from the balance.

CLI: `mentio keywords:create`

Body (JSON):

- `term` (string, required): The word or phrase to track, matched case-insensitively as a phrase.
- `kind` (string): one of `brand`, `competitor`, `topic`. brand: your own names. competitor: theirs. topic: the space. Drives share of voice and segments.
- `platforms` (array of string, nullable): one of `bluesky`, `hackernews`, `github`, `stackoverflow`, `devto`, `reddit`, `x`, `youtube`, `news`, `linkedin`. Platforms to track it on; omit or null for every platform.

Returns: 201, a `Keyword` (see Shapes below).

### GET /v1/keywords/{id}

**Get a keyword.**

CLI: `mentio keywords:get`

Path:

- `id` (string, required): Keyword id (kw_...).

Returns: 200, a `Keyword` (see Shapes below).

### PATCH /v1/keywords/{id}

**Update a keyword.** Mute or unmute it, or change the platforms it is tracked on.

CLI: `mentio keywords:update`

Path:

- `id` (string, required): Keyword id (kw_...).

Body (JSON): Omitted fields are untouched.

- `muted` (boolean): A muted keyword stops polling and matching; its mentions stay.
- `platforms` (array of string, nullable): one of `bluesky`, `hackernews`, `github`, `stackoverflow`, `devto`, `reddit`, `x`, `youtube`, `news`, `linkedin`. Replaces the platform list; null means every platform.

Returns: 200, a `Keyword` (see Shapes below).

### DELETE /v1/keywords/{id}

**Delete a keyword.** Removes the keyword and its matches. Posts also matched by another keyword stay.

CLI: `mentio keywords:delete`

Path:

- `id` (string, required): Keyword id (kw_...).

Returns: 204, no body.

## Shapes

### Keyword

- `id` (string, required): Keyword id (kw_...).
- `term` (string, required)
- `kind` (string, required): one of `brand`, `competitor`, `topic`
- `muted` (boolean, required): Not polled or matched. Either paused by you or by the wallet (see pausedForBalance).
- `pausedForBalance` (boolean, required): Muted by the wallet for lack of balance; a top-up resumes it, unmuting by hand needs balance too.
- `platforms` (array of string, required, nullable): one of `bluesky`, `hackernews`, `github`, `stackoverflow`, `devto`, `reddit`, `x`, `youtube`, `news`, `linkedin`. Platforms this keyword is tracked on; null means every platform.
- `stats` (object, required): Computed over this workspace's matches.
  - `mentions` (integer, required): Every match ever, relevant or not: the number billing counts.
  - `relevant` (integer, required): Matches scored at or above the relevance threshold.
  - `last7d` (integer, required): Matches published in the last 7 days.
  - `lastMentionAt` (string, required, nullable): Newest matched post; null until the first one.
- `polling` (array of object, required): Poll health per platform polled on a schedule. Live feeds (Bluesky) have no entry.
  - `platform` (string, required): one of `bluesky`, `hackernews`, `github`, `stackoverflow`, `devto`, `reddit`, `x`, `youtube`, `news`, `linkedin`. Platform: bluesky, hackernews, github, stackoverflow, devto, reddit, x, youtube, news, linkedin.
  - `lastPolledAt` (string, required, nullable): Newest poll of this platform for the term; null until the first one.
  - `emptyPolls` (integer, required): Consecutive polls that found nothing new; the scheduler slows down as it grows.
- `createdAt` (string, required): ISO 8601 timestamp, UTC.
